text: Sonepar is an independent, family-owned French company: its family shareholders, brought together within the holding Colam Entreprendre, and its associate shareholders hold all of the company's share capital via their respective holding companies, per Sonepar's own website.

source.name: Sonepar, corporate website: Governance – A Family-Owned Company
source.quote: Together, the Group’s family shareholders and associates hold all the company’s share capital via their respective holding companies

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia: Sonepar (History)
additionalSources.quote: The family holding Colam Entreprendre, owner of Sonepar and syndicating inheriting descendants of the Coisne and Lambert families, was created in 2000.
